_about: The N-336 cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The address (the N-336's NATZ lockbox for the client's state: uscis.gov/n-336, updated 06/01/2026), the subject and the fee ($830 on paper, $0 for a military N-400: Form G-1055 10/01/26) come from src/hearing_request.py. The attorney approves this file before volume use.
